assertion.objects: Finite local extensions and continuous de Rham representations, with their filtered period modules.
assertion.hypotheses: Finite-dimensional continuous Q_p representation, de Rham over the base; finite extension in a fixed algebraic closure.
assertion.quantifiers: Every such finite extension and representation.
assertion.parameter_range: All primes, including2; finite extensions only.
assertion.uniformity: Exact functorial identity; no quantitative estimate.
assertion.normalizations: Kato9.3 inverse cup product with log cyclotomic; standard unnormalized corestriction.
assertion.limit_order: Finite local fields and finite sums; products of completions handled by addition.
assertion.statement: The same de Rham base change and inverse cup-log comparison apply to the fixed V and W=V tensor e_chi at the finite conductor fields.

use.reason: Apply Kato9.2/9.3 with the actual finite extension. Over the conductor field W is V tensored with a constant line; finite-extension descent makes W de Rham. The explicit finite-coset calculation and tensor naturality then use these source comparisons.
use.shared_contract_justification: The same finite-extension de Rham comparison supplies these steps for V and its finite-character twist.

supplier.statement: Finite-extension de Rham descent/base change and the section9.3 definition of exp* by inverse cup product with log cyclotomic.

publication.title: p-adic Hodge theory and values of zeta functions of modular forms
publication.corrections: Only finite-extension de Rham comparison and the displayed normalization are imported; the trace identity is derived locally.

use.reason: Use the proved finite trace identity on W, not V at the descended endpoint. Over each conductor-field completion exp*(z_D tensor e_chi)=exp*(z_D) tensor e_chi; the action on e_chi contributes chi(g). Add over completions. Reciprocity and the later invariant-basis scalar calculation remain separate.

supplier.statement: For a finite extension, exp* carries corestriction to field trace; for W=V tensor e_chi, tracing z_D tensor e_chi gives the unnormalized chi-weighted sum with endpoint D_dR^0(K,W).
